text_block_list.text:
While walking through the academy grounds, 
I heard someone's voice.

Haaah... My heart is pounding... Is the 
confession scene coming up next?

Following the sound of the voice, I found 
Mejiro Ryan huddled in secret, reading 
manga.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Man, this author's work really is the 
best... All right, I'm gonna collect all 
the volumes and binge-read the whole 
thing!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Wait, whaaat!? Wh-When did you get here!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I-It's a shoujo manga, sure, but this is, 
um... That's it! A friend recommended it, 
so I had no choice!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
It's definitely not like I just happened 
to find and buy an older work by my 
favorite author, okay?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I don't usually read shoujo manga, okay?! 
Come on, it totally doesn't suit me! 
Ahaha~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Still, I thought I'd read it all in one go 
so I can share my thoughts with my friend 
sooner... Really, that's why!
choice_data_list:
Binge-reading takes a lot out of you, you 
know?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, if that ends up causing sleep 
deprivation, it'll hinder training too...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I want to read it, but I must hold back... 
It's just like biding your time in a race 
to conserve stamina, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Understood. I'll read it at a reasonable 
pace! But remember, I'm only doing this 
because a friend recommended it, okay?!

Whether in racing or reading, paying 
careful attention to pacing is essential.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Hrmm, but I want to read it soon... I 
mean, I want to tell my friend my thoughts 
as soon as possible...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
All right, I'll adjust the schedule so you 
can get plenty of rest after 
binge-reading!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
It's tough, but if I move my morning 
strength training to a different time 
slot, I should be able to manage!

Even while thinking binge-reading isn't 
the best idea, getting proper rest is 
essential.
